title: LACA of 2026
committees: H-Judiciary Committee: Referred To 2025-01-22 -> Markup By 2026-07-15 -> Reported By 2026-08-27
latest_action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 685.
summary: Local Access to Courts Act or LACA This bill adds College Station to the list of places where court must be held in the Galveston Division of the Southern District of Texas. Additionally, the bill adds El Centro to the list of places where court must be held in the Southern District of California.

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
